# Commercial Proposal Engine Plugin Plugin ### Global Generator-Critic (Reflexion) Pipeline for Enterprise Software Engineering Proposals [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Pipeline agêntico nativo em arquitetura Generator-Critic (Reflexion) para geração de Propostas Comerciais Executivas de Engenharia de Software a partir de dossiês técnicos de pré-venda.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/commercial-proposal-engine-plugin ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./commercial-proposal-engine-plugin ``` --- ## 1. Strategic Mission: Bridging Pre-Sales Engineering and Legal Execution In enterprise software engineering, commercial proposals typically fail at one of two extremes: 1. **The Over-Technical Dump:** Dense, disorganized architectural notes that alienate financial sponsors (CEO/CFO), obscuring ROI and business value. 2. **The Superficial Pitch (Slides & Buzzwords):** Vague promises and buzzwords that create major friction and deal breakage when legal teams introduce strict Master Services Agreements (MSAs) and Technical Annexes. The **Commercial Proposal Engine Plugin** (`commercial-proposal-engine-plugin`, v1.0.0) bridges the gap between the upstream **Discovery-to-Proposal Engine** (`DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md`) and the downstream **Contract Technical Annexes Engine** (`ANEXO_TECNICO_MESTRE_CONTRATO.md`). It synthesizes complex technical reality into a single, cohesive narrative across **6 Executive Pillars** and concludes with a consultative **13-Row Contractual Mirror Table** that anchors every legal and operational parameter ahead of contract execution. --- --- ## 2. The 6 Executive Pillars & Contractual Anchoring | Pillar | Subsections & Substance | Target Persona | Downstream Contract Annex Anchored | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. Diagnóstico Executivo & Tese de Valor** | **1.1** As-Is Context & Pains
**1.2** To-Be Vision & Impact
**1.3** Quantified Return Matrix (Baseline vs. Target KPI Table) | CEO / CFO / Business Directors | Sets baseline business context and measurable acceptance metrics | | **2. Solução Proposta & Recorte Estratégico** | **2.1** Noun-based Functional Value Modules
**2.2** Consultative Out-of-Scope (Legacy migration, outdated browsers, direct cloud billing, N1 support) | Product Owner / VP Product | **Anexo 1 — SOW (Seções 1 e 2)** | | **3. Fundação Arquitetural, Resiliência & TCO** | **3.1** Tech Stack & Mermaid Container Topology (`["..."]`)
**3.2** Critical Integrations, Red Flags & CI/CD Staging Mocks
**3.3** InfoSec & LGPD (Controller vs. Operator)
**3.4** Transparent Cloud TCO (Direct Client Sourcing) | CTO / Head of Engineering / InfoSec | **Anexo 1 (Seções 2 e 3), Anexo 2 (LGPD) & Anexo 3 (Mocks)** | | **4. Metodologia de Delivery, Squad & Cronograma** | **4.1** Squad Topology & Seniority Allocation
**4.2** Wave Schedule (Milestones, Sprints, or Inception)
**4.3** Agility Pact (48h PO SLA, 1:1 Freeze, Standby/Remobilization & 5-day Staging UAT Tacit Approval) | Delivery Lead / PMO / Operations | **Anexo 2 — RACI (Seções 3 e 4) & Anexo 3 — Homologação** | | **5. Estrutura de Investimento & Propriedade Intelectual** | **5.1** Pricing Models (Modo A: Fixed Milestones, Modo B: Dedicated Squad, Modo C: Inception, or Modo Híbrido: Inception + Construction Estimate)
**5.2** Evolution Hourly Rate
**5.3** IP Policy (100% Foreground IP upon full payment + Perpetual Background IP License) | CFO / Procurement / Legal | **Anexo 1 — SOW (Seções 4 e 5) & Anexo 4 — Gestão de Mudanças** | | **6. Governança de Mudanças, Garantia & Kick-off** | **6.1** Budget Protection against Informal Channels (WhatsApp ban, 3-axis CR evaluation)
**6.2** 60-day Technical Warranty (SLA P1–P3) vs. Ongoing AMS
**6.3** 3-Step Kick-off Onboarding Roadmap | All Stakeholders | **Anexo 4 — Gestão de Mudanças & Anexo 5 — Garantia & SLA** | | **Anexo Executivo: Quadro de Espelhamento** | **13-Row Consultative Alignment Matrix** bridging proposal conditions directly to Contract Annexes 1–5 in a partnership tone. | General Counsel / Head of Procurement | **Anexos Técnicos 1 a 5 (Consolidação)** | --- --- ## 4. Generator-Critic (Reflexion) Architecture Parallelized writing across multiple agents inevitably generates stylistic fractures and contradictory tones ("Frankenstein text"). To guarantee executive unity, the plugin operates in a closed-loop **Generator-Critic (Reflexion)** pipeline: ```mermaid flowchart TD Dossier["Input Dossier\n(DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md)"] --> Check{"Step 0: File Check\n(Does file exist?)"} Check -->|No| Abort["Friendly Guidance\n(Run Discovery Engine first)"] Check -->|Yes| Planner["Step 1: Ingestion & Narrative Planner\n(proposal-ingestion-planner.md)"] Params["Commercial Params\n(Pricing / Rates / Model)"] --> Planner Planner --> PlanJSON[".scratch/proposal_narrative_plan.json\n(Canonical Plan + Smart Fallbacks)"] Template["Skill Template\n(Context Injection)"] --> Generator["Step 2: Executive Proposal Generator\n(executive-proposal-generator.md)"] PlanJSON --> Generator Generator --> DraftV1[".scratch/PROPOSTA_DRAFT_V1.md\n(6 Pillars + Mermaid + 13-Row Mirror)"] DraftV1 --> Critic["Step 3: Deal Red Team Critic\n(deal-redteam-critic.md)"] PlanJSON --> Critic Critic --> CritiqueJSON[".scratch/redteam_critique.json\n(4 Lenses: Scores >= 8.5 & Min 8.0)"] CritiqueJSON -->|REVISION_REQUIRED| Reflexion["Step 4: Surgical Reflexion Refinement\n(executive-proposal-generator.md)"] CritiqueJSON -->|APPROVED| SanityCheck["Step 4: Deterministic Sanity Check\n(Zero HTML Comments / Whitelist Only)"] Reflexion --> SanityCheck SanityCheck --> Final["PROPOSTA_COMERCIAL_EXECUTIVA.md\n(Clean, Audited Final Proposal)"] ``` --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`commercial-persuasion-standards.md`](rules/commercial-persuasion-standards.md)**: Aplicar exclusivamente durante o planejamento, redação ou revisão crítica (Red Team) de propostas comerciais executivas de engenharia de software. - **[`contractual-anchoring-safeguards.md`](rules/contractual-anchoring-safeguards.md)**: Aplicar exclusivamente durante o planejamento, redação ou revisão crítica (Red Team) de propostas comerciais executivas de engenharia de software para ancorar salvaguardas contratuais. ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/commercial-proposal-orchestrator`](skills/commercial-proposal-orchestrator/SKILL.md)**: Orquestra o pipeline agêntico em loop Generator-Critic (Reflexion) para transformar o dossiê técnico de pré-venda (DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md) em uma Proposta Comercial e Técnica Executiva de alto impacto (PROPOSTA_COMERCIAL_EXECUTIVA.md), estruturada nos 6 Pilares Executivos e pré-alinhada com os 5 Anexos Técnicos Contratuais. ### Specialized Subagents (`agents/`) Autonomous personas delegated for in-depth execution: - **[`deal-redteam-critic`](agents/deal-redteam-critic.md)**: Atua como Critic no loop Reflexion. Audita a minuta da proposta sob 4 lentes (Persuasão C-Level, Rigor CTO/TCO, Ancoragem dos 5 Anexos Contratuais e Higiene de Output), emitindo parecer estruturado em .scratch/redteam_critique.json. - **[`executive-proposal-generator`](agents/executive-proposal-generator.md)**: Atua como Generator no loop Reflexion. Redige a Proposta Comercial Executiva completa em voz única e fluida nos 6 pilares e aplica os refinamentos exigidos pelo Deal Red Team Critic. - **[`proposal-ingestion-planner`](agents/proposal-ingestion-planner.md)**: Analisa o dossiê técnico de pré-venda, valida premissas estruturais, aplica fallbacks comerciais inteligentes e estrutura o plano narrativo da proposta em .scratch/proposal_narrative_plan.json. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text commercial-proposal-engine-plugin/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── commercial-persuasion-standards.md │ └── contractual-anchoring-safeguards.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── commercial-proposal-orchestrator/ │ └── SKILL.md └── agents/ # Specialized autonomous subagents └── deal-redteam-critic.md └── executive-proposal-generator.md └── proposal-ingestion-planner.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown - "Execute o pipeline multi-agente de proposta comercial a partir do dossiê técnico" - "Audite a viabilidade comercial, margem de risco e premissas contratuais da proposta" - "Estruture a proposta comercial consolidada com marcos de faturamento e cronograma" ``` --- ## 📄 License & Corporate Governance Distributed under the **MIT License**.
